highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates platform integrations and fixes reliability and performance issues across managed and native code.
highlights_body: The release aligns Uno and Windows dependencies with current platform versions, refreshes the bundled Skia m156 fixes, and improves image, stream, string, Android, and HarfBuzz workloads.

bullets.detail: Incorporates the latest upstream Chrome m156 bug fixes into the renderer shipped with SkiaSharp.
StringUtilities now validates Unicode character codes and string inputs correctly, and native C-string conversion no longer reads beyond its source buffer.

bullets.lead: Image and text processing allocations reduced
bullets.detail: Managed image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature-string parsing avoid unnecessary allocations while preserving their results.

bullets.lead: Stream and Android rendering behavior stabilized
bullets.detail: Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily, and Android texture rendering is synchronized with display refresh.
SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI now builds against Uno Platform 7, while Windows native dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10.
Apple deployment targets, Windows build tooling, and bundled WebGPU support are updated for current platform environments.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Updated Uno Platform support and bundled the WebGPU implementation in the native library
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bound bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux and improved Blazor CPU sample test synchronization
contributor_summaries.akoeplinger: Disabled the Azure DevOps Dependabot configuration
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Addressed contextual policy findings in CI
